title: DeepSeek R1 model triggers global AI-chip selloff; Nvidia falls ~17% in a single session
content: A low-cost Chinese AI model rattled assumptions about AI capex, sparking a sharp global selloff in semiconductor and AI names. Nvidia lost roughly 17% in one day, dragging TSMC and the broader AI supply chain lower.

title: US administration signals sweeping new tariffs on steel, aluminum and major trading partners
content: Escalating tariff rhetoric raised the risk of a broad trade conflict, pressuring equity risk appetite though no concrete reciprocal-tariff schedule was yet published.

title: US equities slide on growth-scare as soft data and tariff uncertainty weigh
content: The S&P 500 entered a correction intra-quarter as consumer sentiment weakened and tariff uncertainty clouded the outlook; some commentary called a possible growth slowdown but signals were not confirmed.

title: Liberation Day: US announces sweeping reciprocal tariffs, triggering worst global equity rout since 2020
content: The US unveiled broad reciprocal tariffs on nearly all trading partners. Global equities crashed over the following sessions, with the S&P 500 down double digits and Taiwan's market hit hard on export and semiconductor exposure. A level-3 alert for systemic risk.

title: Taiwan's TAIEX plunges nearly 10% at the open, largest single-day drop on record, as tariff shock hits TSMC
content: The Taiwan Stock Exchange opened with a record intraday plunge of nearly 10% on the first trading day after the reciprocal-tariff shock, with TSMC and exporters limit-down on direct US-tariff exposure.

title: US announces 90-day pause on most reciprocal tariffs; global equities stage historic one-day rebound
content: A 90-day pause on most country-specific tariffs (China excepted) sparked one of the largest single-day rallies in years, with the S&P 500 up roughly 9-10% and Taiwan rebounding sharply.

title: US and China agree in Geneva to sharply cut tariffs for 90 days; risk assets rally
content: Negotiators agreed to roll back the bulk of the April tariff escalation for 90 days. Equities extended their recovery and volatility fell.

title: Taiwan dollar surges most in decades, up ~5% in two sessions, pressuring exporters' margins
content: The New Taiwan dollar appreciated sharply against the US dollar in its biggest two-day move in decades, raising concerns over exporter and life-insurer FX losses, though equities held up.

title: Israel launches large-scale strikes on Iran; oil spikes and risk assets wobble as 12-day war begins
content: Israeli strikes on Iranian targets opened a 12-day conflict. Brent crude spiked and equities saw a risk-off move on escalation and supply fears.

title: US strikes Iranian nuclear sites; markets brace for retaliation but oil reverses lower within days
content: US forces struck Iranian nuclear facilities. Despite initial fears, a ceasefire followed and oil gave back its war premium, with equities resuming their climb.

title: TSMC posts record quarterly profit on AI demand, raises full-year revenue guidance
content: TSMC reported a record quarter driven by AI accelerator demand and lifted its 2025 revenue growth outlook, reinforcing the AI capex narrative. A positive earnings surprise.

title: US strikes trade frameworks with Japan and the EU ahead of tariff deadline; markets hit new highs
content: A series of bilateral trade frameworks reduced tail-risk from the tariff standoff, helping global equities push to fresh record highs.

title: Fed Chair signals openness to rate cuts at Jackson Hole as labor market cools
content: At Jackson Hole the Fed Chair opened the door to easing, citing downside labor-market risks, fueling a rally in rate-sensitive assets.

title: Federal Reserve cuts rates by 25bp, its first cut of 2025, and signals further easing
content: The FOMC lowered the policy rate by 25 basis points amid a softening labor market and projected additional cuts, broadly as expected.

title: US federal government enters shutdown after funding lapse; data releases delayed
content: A funding impasse triggered a federal government shutdown, delaying key economic data. Market reaction was initially muted but added uncertainty.

title: Fed delivers second consecutive 25bp cut; Chair pushes back on a December cut being a foregone conclusion
content: The Fed cut again but signaled a December move was not guaranteed, cooling some rate-cut optimism and lifting volatility modestly.

title: AI-bubble fears spark sharp pullback in megacap tech and semiconductors
content: Stretched AI valuations and circular-financing concerns drove a sharp pullback in megacap tech and chip names, with elevated volatility through mid-November.

title: Unverified report suggests possible softening in regional manufacturing surveys
content: An unconfirmed note pointed to a possible weakening in some regional PMIs; the signal was unclear and not corroborated by official data.

title: Fed cuts rates a third time in 2025 as inflation eases; equities close the year near record highs
content: A December rate cut amid easing inflation supported a year-end rally, with US and Taiwan equities finishing 2025 near record highs.

title: Taiwan's TAIEX closes 2025 at a record high, up strongly on the year led by AI supply chain
content: Taiwan equities ended 2025 at record levels, with TSMC and the AI supply chain driving strong full-year gains despite the April tariff shock.
